This is a list of themes that have been played in the {{pmin|Bulgaria}}n dub of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. ==Openings== The openings for the [[S02|second]] to the [[S05|fifth]] and the [[S10|tenth]] to [[S11|eleventh seasons]] were left undubbed, though the Intros to the [[M02|second]] and [[M03|third movies]] were dubbed. ===[[Pokémon Theme]]=== [[File:OPE01.png|250px|thumb|Indigo League]] This opening was sung by Юксел Ахмедов ''Yuksel Ahmedov'' and the group Индиго ''Indigo''. The [[M01|movie]] used an instrumental version of the song. {{Schemetable|Kanto}} ! Bulgarian ! Transcription ! English |- | Най-добър да бъда аз, да нямам равен днес!
